content: मुण्ड {%a.%} [मुण्ड्-घञ्] .²1 Shaved, bald; रावणश्च मया दृष्टो मुण्डस्तैलसमुक्षितः <ls>Rām. 5. 27. 19</ls>; चरन् भैक्ष्यं मुनिर्मुण्डः <ls>Mb. 12. 9. 12</ls>. .²2 Lopped, stripped of top leaves. .²3 Blunt, pointless. .²4 <ab>Ved.</ab> Hornless. .²5 Low, mean. .{@-ण्डः@} .²1 A man with a shaved or bald head; स्वप्नेऽवगाहतेऽत्यर्थं जलं मुण्डांश्च पश्यति <ls>Y. 1. 272</ls>. .²2 A bald or shaven head. .²3 The forehead. .²4 A barber. .²5 The trunk of a tree stripped of its top-branches; मुण्डतालवनानीव चकार स रथव्रजान् <ls>Mb. 6. 106. 14</ls>. .²6 An epithet of Rāhu. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the twelve principal Upaniṣads; मुण्डमाण्डूक्यतित्तिरिः. --{%m.%} <ab>pl.</ab> <ab>N.</ab> of a people. .{@-ण्डा@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a plant (मुण्डीरिका). .²2 Bengal madder. .²3 A female mendicant of a particular order. .{@-ण्डम्@} .²1 The head; अङ्गं गलितं पलितं मुण्डम् <ls>Śaṅkara.</ls> .²2 Myrrh. .²3 Iron.
